notes.title: First DLC-collection
notes.content:
Hello everyone! While the second episode is being forged in the furnaces of our studio, we want to brighten your wait with the first set of promised additions.

Original Soundtrack
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44603423/e1fc008e41b2bcf1210eda3e221ca72e0b6cb03f.jpg
Tracks by Pazetic Ocean, Leety, and Between August and December (special guest!).
The soundtrack is updated during the game's development. Currently, it includes tracks from the first episode of the visual novel.
All proceeds will be distributed among the music authors.
Please note: the price may increase as updates are released.

Free music Collection
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44603423/6d54d9f95903efd40b2be037a3b8d472242d6693.jpg
A free selection of music used in the visual novel. The collection is updated as the game progresses.

Audio Drama №1
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44603423/63c878356f40bb2527c2f0799fa2f880f27ead44.jpg
A bonus New Year's story that takes place before the events of the game. Available only in Russian (english subtitles are available)!
Includes both audio and video versions. Duration: 33 minutes.


A bundle with all of the above is also available at an additional discount.

notes.title: Little update
notes.content:
- added a small piece of text to the date in Yana's day 2
- added illustration in day 6 of Kristina with PalPalych's car
- changed the order in the gallery, updated the gallery interface
- fixed a bug that made it impossible to see CG with Anya and popsicle in the gallery
- other minor edits to text, art and script.

Thanks to everyone who sends their feedback and comments!

notes.title: Thanks for your support at LDAwards2023!
notes.content:
Thank you for your support! According to the readers of LD | Visual Novel News, we were able to take honors in various categories:
- 3rd place for "Event of the Year"
- 2nd place for "Best Novel in Development".
- 1st place for "Release of the Year"!
It was very unexpected and pleasant :)
